excluded: unknown raw IDs without a placeholder

checks.browser: Placeholder-only request by default; separate explicit diagnostic request; scope labels; existing preview/stage/backup/selection/inventory workflows; safe diagnostics and read-only permissions; mobile layout; no browser exceptions
checks.package: Mod version, bundled guide/DLL byte identity, no website/connector or root native SQLite DLL verified

limits: Synthetic saved chunks and browser fixtures, not the production world, were tested.
Server missing-block definitions are detected; player camera visibility and client texture failures are not.
Underground/unloaded saved placeholders still count; plants already saved as air require location/history evidence.
